# Connect to Pools (Instance Pools)
Source: https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/compute/pool-index
Fetched: 2026-06-16
Last updated on page: Oct 29, 2024

## Connect to pools
"Databricks pools are a set of idle, ready-to-use instances. When cluster nodes are created using the idle instances, cluster start and auto-scaling times are reduced."
"Databricks does not charge DBUs while instances are idle in the pool. Instance provider billing does apply."

## Create a pool
Requires "Allow pool creation" entitlement.
"By default, only workspace admins have the pool creation entitlement."
"Non-admin users with the Allow pool creation entitlement can only create pools using the CLI or API. The Create Pool button in the UI is available only to workspace admins."
Steps: Compute > Pools tab > Create Pool > configure > Create.

## Attach a cluster to a pool
UI: "select the pool from the Driver Type or Worker Type dropdown when you configure the cluster."
API: specify `driver_instance_pool_id` for the driver node and `instance_pool_id` for the worker nodes.

## Pool permissions
"There are three permission levels for a pool: NO PERMISSIONS, CAN ATTACH TO, and CAN MANAGE."
Manage permissions: must have CAN MANAGE on the pool.
Configurable via workspace UI, Permissions API, or Terraform provider.

## Delete a pool
"Terminates the pool's idle instances and removes its configuration."
"You cannot undo this action."
Running clusters attached to the pool continue to run but cannot allocate instances during resize or up-scaling.
Terminated clusters attached to the pool will fail to start.
